# Thiruvananthapuram Set to Host Two-Day Symposium on Nuclear Science and Technology

Thiruvananthapuram is preparing to host a two-day symposium dedicated to nuclear science and technology. The event will bring focus to the scientific and technological advancements shaping the nuclear sector.

The program has been planned as a two-day gathering. Throughout the duration of the event, activities and presentations will center on topics directly connected to nuclear science, research, and technical applications.

By serving as the venue for the symposium, Thiruvananthapuram will be the central location for the scheduled sessions. The city will accommodate the activities planned across both days of the scientific forum.

Notice of the upcoming event was reported by The Times of India and distributed across technology news platforms, drawing public attention to the planned gathering.

Additional logistical details, including the specific venue within the city, dates, scheduled speakers, and organizational partners, were not detailed in the initial report. Further information is anticipated as official announcements regarding the program schedule are made available.
